verdict.rationale: Stripe docs show custom Radar rules can act on risk score and other attributes to allow, block, require 3DS, or route to review (docs-1,17,23,3), plus a review queue (docs-18/24) and adjustable risk-setting thresholds tied to business risk tolerance (docs-13,25). However, community feedback flags friction in tuning this to a business's own appetite — lack of easy programmatic control causing rising false positives (comm-2) and Allow Rules requiring manual support enablement rather than self-service tuning (comm-7). missing for 10: independent confirmation that score-range-to-action mapping and threshold tuning work smoothly/self-service without support intervention, and clearer first-party documentation of a numeric score-to-action matrix (vs. rule-based heuristics).
